{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 216,
      "where": "Exemple 2.15, condition (i)",
      "scan": "noethérien (i.e. tout ouvert de X est quasi-compact), i.e. toute suite croissante d'ouverts de X est stationnaire)",
      "tex": "noethérien (\\ie tout ouvert de $X$ est\nquasi-compact), \\ie toute suite croissante d'ouverts de $X$ est\nstationnaire);",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "noethérien (\\ie tout ouvert de $X$ est quasi-compact, \\ie toute suite croissante d'ouverts de $X$ est stationnaire);",
      "note": "The explanation has two closing parentheses for one opening parenthesis. TeX retains the printed misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 216,
      "where": "Exemple 2.15, proof, name of the generating subcategory",
      "scan": "Ouv(X)",
      "tex": "ouv(X)",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "ouv(X)",
        "new": "Ouv(X)"
      },
      "note": "The printed category name begins with a capital O."
    },
    {
      "page": 216,
      "where": "2.15.1, first sentence",
      "scan": "les espaces topologiques",
      "tex": "les espaces topologique",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "espaces topologique.",
        "new": "espaces topologiques."
      },
      "note": "The printed adjective is plural."
    },
    {
      "page": 217,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16, introductory paragraph, induced topos",
      "scan": "E_{/X'}",
      "tex": "E_{/X}",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "E_{/X}",
        "new": "E_{/X'}"
      },
      "note": "The print has a prime: the slice is over X', not X."
    },
    {
      "page": 217,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 b), first sentence",
      "scan": "l'objet de E définit par",
      "tex": "l'objet de $E$ définit par",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "l'objet de $E$ défini par",
      "note": "The participle should be « défini ». TeX retains the printed « définit »."
    },
    {
      "page": 218,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 b), continuation, definition of T_U",
      "scan": "$T_U = G \\times U$",
      "tex": "$T_U = G \\times U$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$T_U = U \\times G$",
      "note": "The following action and structural-map formulas use coordinates (u,g), with the U-coordinate first. The printed product has its factors reversed; TeX retains it."
    },
    {
      "page": 218,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 b), continuation, introduction of the structural map",
      "scan": "et le morphisme structural",
      "tex": "et la morphisme structural",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "la morphisme",
        "new": "le morphisme"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « le », not « la »."
    },
    {
      "page": 218,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 b), continuation, formula for the structural map",
      "scan": "$P_U(u,g)=g\\cdot u$",
      "tex": "$P_U(u, g) = g\\cdot u$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$p_U(u, g) = g\\cdot u$",
      "note": "The map is introduced immediately before this as lowercase p_U, but the print uses uppercase P_U in its defining formula. TeX retains this inconsistency."
    },
    {
      "page": 218,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 c), parenthetical description of quasi-separated X",
      "scan": "un ouvert quasi-compact",
      "tex": "un ouverts quasi-compact",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "un ouverts quasi-compact",
        "new": "un ouvert quasi-compact"
      },
      "note": "The print has singular « ouvert »."
    },
    {
      "page": 218,
      "where": "Exercice 2.16 d), first assertion",
      "scan": "P → e est quasi-compact si et seulement si G est fini.",
      "tex": "$P \\to e$ est quasi-compact\n  si et seulement si $G$ est fini.",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Le morphisme structural $P \\to e$ est quasi-compact si et seulement si $G$ est fini ou $X$ vide.",
      "note": "The printed assertion omits the empty-space exception: when X is empty, the map is quasi-compact for every G. The next assertion explicitly accounts for this exception. TeX retains the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 220,
      "where": "Exercice 2.17 c), introduction of the finite family of diagrams",
      "scan": "une famille finie de diagramme commutatifs",
      "tex": "une famille finie de diagramme commutatifs",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "une famille finie de diagrammes commutatifs",
      "note": "The noun should be plural. TeX retains the printed « diagramme »."
    },
    {
      "page": 220,
      "where": "Exercice 2.17 c), criterion for E to be algebraic",
      "scan": "à la condition de b)",
      "tex": "à la conditions de b)",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "la conditions de b)",
        "new": "la condition de b)"
      },
      "note": "The print has singular « condition » here."
    },
    {
      "page": 220,
      "where": "Exercice 2.17 c), final sentence",
      "scan": "qu'il existe une sous-catégorie finale",
      "tex": "qu'il existe un\nsous-catégorie finale",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "existe un\nsous-catégorie",
        "new": "existe une\nsous-catégorie"
      },
      "note": "The printed article is « une »."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "Counts (normal/misprint): 216: 2/1; 217: 1/1; 218: 2/3; 219: 0/0; 220: 2/1."
}
